questions.prompt: Calculate the dot product for two integer vectors. Read n, then n integers for the query vector and n integers for the document vector from standard input. Print the sum of the products at matching positions as a single integer. Assume 1 ≤ n ≤ 100 and each coordinate is between −100 and 100.
questions.explanation: The dot product sums the product of corresponding coordinates. Keeping the output as a single integer makes it possible to compare the result directly against the test cases.

languages.starter:
import sys

values = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
n = values[0]
query = values[1:n + 1]
document_vector = values[n + 1:]

# Calculate and print the dot product.
languages.solution:
import sys

values = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
n = values[0]
query = values[1:n + 1]
document_vector = values[n + 1:]
print(sum(a * b for a, b in zip(query, document_vector)))

questions.prompt: Choose a vector-search candidate from one tenant. Read n and a target tenant ID, then n rows containing document ID, tenant ID, and integer similarity score. Consider only rows for the requested tenant. Print the document ID with the highest score, choosing the smallest ID on ties. Print −1 if the tenant has no candidates. Document and tenant IDs are positive integers. Scores can be negative.
questions.explanation: Filter candidates by tenant before ranking them. Breaking score ties by ID produces a stable result even when candidates arrive in a different order.

languages.starter:
import sys

values = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
n, target = values[:2]

# Filter, rank, and print the selected document ID.
languages.solution:
import sys

values = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
n, target = values[:2]
best = None
for index in range(2, 2 + n * 3, 3):
    doc, tenant, score = values[index:index + 3]
    candidate = (-score, doc)
    if tenant == target and (best is None or candidate < best):
        best = candidate
print(-1 if best is None else best[1])

languages.solution:
<?php
$values = array_map('intval', preg_split('/\s+/', trim(stream_get_contents(STDIN))));
$n = $values[0];
$target = $values[1];
$bestId = -1;
$bestScore = PHP_INT_MIN;
for ($i = 2; $i < 2 + $n * 3; $i += 3) {
    [$id, $tenant, $score] = array_slice($values, $i, 3);
    if ($tenant === $target && ($bestId === -1 || $score > $bestScore || ($score === $bestScore && $id < $bestId))) {
        $bestScore = $score;
        $bestId = $id;
    }
}
echo $bestId . PHP_EOL;

n, target = values.first(2)

puts(match ? match[0] : -1)

#!/usr/bin/env bash
read -r n target
best_id=-1
for ((i = 0; i < n; i++)); do
    read -r id tenant score
    if ((tenant == target)) && { ((best_id == -1)) || ((score > best_score || (score == best_score && id < best_id))); }; then
        best_id=$id
        best_score=$score
    fi
done
printf '%d\n' "$best_id"

local values = {}
for token in io.read('*a'):gmatch('%S+') do
    values[#values + 1] = tonumber(token)
end
local n, target = values[1], values[2]
local best_id, best_score = -1, -math.huge
for i = 3, n * 3, 3 do
    local id, tenant, score = values[i], values[i + 1], values[i + 2]
    if tenant == target and (score > best_score or (score == best_score and id < best_id)) then
        best_id, best_score = id, score
    end
end
print(best_id)
